_comment: Per-build UI gate manifest. Each entry in 'disabled' is a widget identifier whose runtime state is forced to disabled (greyed out, still drawn). Each entry in 'removed' is a UI element that is stripped from the layout entirely (widget hidden, dropdown entry omitted, language filtered from the language selector). See disabled_settings.txt at repo root for the human-facing summary of why each entry is gated. This file is embedded into the binary at build time by cmake/EmbedFileAsArray.cmake; see src/openrct2/ui/DisabledSettings.cpp for the runtime consumer.
